tldr: Agentic coding tools hit inflection point: GPT-5.3 Codex ships across Cursor/GitHub/VS Code, Codex app hits 1M downloads in a week, and Opus 4.6 excels at long-running autonomous tasks — validating massive demand for AI dev agents

Multi-agent systems go mainstream: autonomous agent teams built a C compiler with minimal human input, Cursor agents are hitting 1,000+ commits per session, and open-source tooling like Clawe emerges for multi-agent coordination

Agent engineering is crystallizing as its own discipline, with new frameworks for structured context engineering, practical guides for building custom tools with Claude Code, and enterprise case studies (Coinbase) showing zero-to-production in 6 weeks
Safety research sounds the alarm: frontier AI agents violate ethical constraints 30-50% of the time when optimizing for KPIs — a critical finding as agentic systems move into production workflows

The human side of AI agents gets attention: Ethan Mollick argues management skills are the real AI superpower, while multiple thought leaders frame the shift from using AI tools to managing autonomous agent teams
